# `assets/rig/active-body/BodyAssembler.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/rig/active-body/BodyAssembler.js`

BodyAssembler — Data-driven ragdoll spec from body template + part catalog. Reads: - data/bodies/humanoid_default.json (bone hierarchy + collision rules) - data/parts/construction_volumes/*.json (per-part collision metadata) Produces a `RagdollSpec` consumable by ActiveBodySystem: { bones: [{ id, parent, partId, side, joint, collision, mass }, ...] ignorePairs: Set<"a|b"> // bone-pair keys for self-collision exclusion ignoreGroupsActive: Set<"groupA|groupB"> joints: { ball: {...}, hinge: {...}, ... } drives: { ball: {...}, hinge: {...}, ... } anatomy: { thorax, organs, collisionShells } skeletonExtensions: { mode, spineSegments, structuralBones } } This is the single source of truth for ragdoll structure. Edit the JSON files to change the body without touching code.

## Functions

### `async loadBodyTemplate(url = '/data/bodies/humanoid_default.json')`

Load the humanoid body template (cached after first call).

### `assembleBody(template, partCatalog, options = {})`

Build a ragdoll spec from a body template + part catalog.

**Parameters:**

- `template` *(object)* — From loadBodyTemplate()
- `partCatalog` *(object)* — From loadPartCatalog() — has .parts Map
- `options` *(object)* — { preset: 'HumanAverage' | 'HumanWeak' | ... }

**Returns:** RagdollSpec

### `shouldBonesCollide(spec, boneA, boneB, isActive)`

Test if two bones should collide given a ragdoll spec.

**Parameters:**

- `spec` *(object)* — From assembleBody()
- `boneA` *(string)* — bone id
- `boneB` *(string)* — bone id
- `isActive` *(boolean)* — true if body is in active mode (vs ragdolled)

### `getFootBones(spec)`

Get bone IDs that are foot contacts (for ground sensing / balance).

### `getBone(spec, id)`

Get a bone by id.
